offering_description.value: Bioventus sells joint injections for osteoarthritis, bone graft materials and ultrasonic instruments for surgery, and prescription devices that help fractures heal. It develops and manufactures devices, sources some injectables from manufacturing partners, and supplies clinics, hospitals, surgery centers, and patients.

primary_products.value: hyaluronic acid joint injections; bone graft substitutes; ultrasonic surgical instruments; ultrasound bone growth stimulators

customer_segment.value: B2B: Orthopedic clinics, hospitals, and ambulatory surgery centers; B2C: Patients prescribed bone growth stimulators for home use

end_markets.value: osteoarthritis care; spine surgery; orthopedic surgery; fracture care

revenue_model.value: product sales: Joint injections, bone graft materials, surgical instruments, and bone growth stimulators; healthcare reimbursement: Insurer payments for covered prescription bone growth stimulators

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: Makes surgical devices and bone healing products for hospitals, clinics, and patients; distributor: Supplies clinics with joint injections sourced from manufacturing partners

geography_served.value: global: United States, Canada, Europe, and other international markets

specialization.value: related lines: Osteoarthritis pain treatments, surgical instruments and bone graft materials, and fracture healing devices

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: Field sales teams serving clinics and hospitals, with home delivery for prescribed bone growth stimulators; distributors / dealers: Independent medical device distributors in selected markets

regulatory_exposure.value: high: FDA and international medical device requirements for marketing authorization, manufacturing quality, and postmarket surveillance

notes: The exact current ordering of the surgical and fracture healing lines is uncertain.
